label: 2MP outdoor IR dome IP camera
description: 2 MP outdoor vandal-resistant dome with OptimizedIR and deep-learning analytics, 10/100 RJ45. PoE 802.3af/802.3at Type 1 Class 3, 4.8 W typical, 10.7 W max with IR on.
notes: PoE class 802.3af (Type 1 Class 3), 12.95 W. Wired only. IR illuminator pushes draw to 10.7 W, which is the number to use for switch budget planning, not the 4.8 W typical figure.
